name: Pro SQL Console
description: Schema-aware SQL workbench: CodeMirror 6 editor with an in-house SQL tokenizer, table/column/alias autocomplete and lint squiggles with quick fixes, run selection or statement under cursor, cancellable multi-tab queries, searchable history, schema browser, and a virtualised sortable, resizable result grid (100k rows) with keyboard navigation and CSV export.

props.name: schema
props.description: Tables (name, schema, columns with type/pk/nullable/description, rowCount) driving completion, lint and the schema browser

props.name: onRun
props.description: Executes SQL. Reject with { message, position? } to show an error with a jump-to link; honour signal to support Cancel

props.name: tabs / defaultTabs / onTabsChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled query tabs; createQueryTab() builds one

props.name: historyKey
props.description: Persist run history in localStorage under this key

usage:
<ProSqlConsole
  schema={tables}
  onRun={(sql, { signal }) => api.query(sql, { signal })}
  historyKey="sql-history"
/>
